crossRefs.note: Praise be to Yahweh God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.
Who is like you, Yahweh, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;
They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works…

translations.web: to him who alone does great wonders; for his loving kindness endures forever:
translations.bsb: He alone does great wonders. His loving devotion endures forever.
translations.kjv: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.
translations.asv: To him who alone doeth great wonders; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:
